column1: # Instrument inventory — per measurement class the instrument, its band, and the evidence.
# Why this file: the register (phi/sources.φ) carries force, unit and cadence per
# field, but neither the instrument nor its band. Without that column the only
# search axis left is the brand in the URL — exactly the mistake that cost the
# Schumann route and the MISCHA blocks.
#   klasse      force/unit, as counted by `bin/instrumente` (lower case)
#   instrument  measuring device (not brand), e.g. "Fluxgate-Magnetometer"; a
#               tool is not one: a compiler or a search measures nothing
#   band        measurement band, e.g. "DC-64 Hz" — empty while unread
#   beleg       URL carrying the sentence; empty = not researched yet
# `bin/instrumente` counts rows/cadences/licenses per class from the register
